baseline_source: Fresh normal count-zero gate, then the first 5 complete quiet DIFF frames spanning 101ms. Replay must rebuild this baseline and must not train on contact frames.

activity_segmentation.method: Any absolute per-channel baseline-subtracted DIFF >20; new activity burst after >100ms between active frames. Only retrospective sequence association.

source_integrity.termination: 60-second deadline followed by successful normal-page restoration; event details -9 are normal session expiry, not transport errors.

action_windows.label_source: User-confirmed action order; associated with the nth data-derived activity burst, not an independently timed annotation.

limits: All 2241 frames remain one real session and are replayed chronologically; no shuffled train/test or invented held-out sample.
These same frames informed the proposed changes. Per-action windows and coordinates are not independent ground truth.
The labels establish requested/confirmed order only. Do not infer exact accuracy, direction correctness, true contact IDs/count, or physical coordinate calibration.
No independent one-finger, three-finger, edge-position, rotated-device, new-user or separate-session negatives were captured in this dynamic session.
Candidate tap/scroll counters are diagnostics only; this fixture never authorizes HID output.
